notes.title: Steam TPS Fest Sale Update!
notes.notes:
[h2]Bug Fixes / QoL[/h2]
* Fixed the one-shots that were happening from some boss weapons and explosions. These weren't intentional.
* Commando can no longer RPG himself to death, that wasn't intentional either.
* Fixed some weirdness between saves, and some crashes on level transitions.
* Added a tutorial for the Commando Knife in Level 1.

[h2]Freedom Is 33% Off[/h2]
Eye of the Commando is on sale for Steam's Third Person Shooter Fest! If you're reading this you probably already own the game so that isn't really super exciting for you, but maybe for one of your friends? Three of your friends?

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3016480/Eye_of_the_Commando/][img]https://i.imgur.com/jiyyUMw.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Build 1.1a with some minor bug fixes
notes.notes: If you were having trouble loading saves, that should be fixed now. Also corrected some stuff with knockback on slime enemies, and the music fading out if you restart the first level.

notes.title: 14 October hotfix
notes.notes:
Corrected a few minor issues, and one major one: saving and loading shouldn't break on level 2 anymore.

Pay no attention to the knife in the bottom right of the UI.

notes.title: 20 September hotfix
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed Destroy inventory slot not working.
[*] Fixed a couple of bugs with the Combinator. But not all!
[/list]

notes.title: 19 September Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hey you, thanks for getting in on the ground floor of an Early Access game! New content will happen before long, but right now I'm fixing bugs and working on save/load. Today's fixes/updates:

[list]
[*] Battle Alloy cubes can no longer be placed in the Sub Weapon slot.
[*] Certain blown up walls shouldn't shrink any more when you enter their space.
[*] Added an additional Duct Tape to the level 5 shop. 
[*] Weapon Attachments max out at 5, even Duct Tape has limits.
[*] Fixed steamdeck and gamepad input for a particular late game UI.
[*] Fixed out of place text for final Area Clear screen. For all of you who've seen that screen.
[*] Conveyor belt control console should be a little more obvious. 
[/list]
